walkthroughs.title: Welcome to Paradise Code
walkthroughs.description: Your local workspace, with familiar tools.

steps.title: Open your project
steps.description:
Choose File → Open Folder (⌥⌘O). Your files stay on your Mac.
[Show Explorer](command:workbench.view.explorer)

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.description:
Install ESLint, Prettier, themes, and other compatible extensions from Open VSX. You can also install a VSIX file.
[Browse extensions](command:workbench.view.extensions)

steps.title: Build, run, and debug
steps.description:
Node and npm are included. Use the integrated terminal, Tasks, Git, and the Node debugger.
[Open a terminal](command:workbench.action.terminal.new)

steps.title: Keep your SSD connected
steps.description:
Paradise keeps its profile and caches on the ParadiseCodeBuild volume. Mount it before launching. Updates are installed manually.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings)
